patronOf.en-US: The Heart that has so loved men
patronOf.pt-BR: O Coração que tanto amou os homens

prayerExcerpt.en-US: The designs of his Heart are from age to age, to rescue their souls from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Os desígnios do Coração do Senhor perduram de geração em geração, para da morte libertar as suas vidas e alimentá-los quando é tempo de penúria.

meta.face: Christ as in recurring-figures.md: a man of about thirty-three with a LONG OVAL face narrowing gently to the chin — a high, smooth forehead, a long straight nose with a fine bridge, calm almond-shaped dark-brown eyes under level brown brows, high, softly modelled cheekbones, a quiet closed mouth; chestnut-brown hair parted in the centre and falling in soft waves past the shoulders; a short, full chestnut beard and moustache, lightly parted at the chin; a plain gold halo; he looks straight out at the viewer with a gentle, inviting gaze.
meta.basis: The image follows St. Margaret Mary Alacoque's description of the 1673–75 revelations at Paray-le-Monial (the Heart on a throne of flames, crowned with thorns, surmounted by a cross), as painted in the nineteenth-century devotional type. Christ keeps the set's face.

sources.title: Catholic Encyclopedia (1910): Devotion to the Sacred Heart of Jesus
